mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% and federal funds rate is above 4.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion, defined by GDP growth exceeding 2.5% and industrial production above 102.0, signals an overheating economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the regime effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weak labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% and federal funds rate is above 4.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0, it signals a strong supply-side economy that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the regime effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher residential sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-residential-sales periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
